findings.title: Brief stale error when returning to a previously failed folder while another fetch is pending
findings.evidence: FileBrowserRegion.tsx:283 loadState derives from settled.folder === contextFolder; settled stays {docs,error} while src is pending; browsing back to docs shows the alert (now tested first) instead of Loading until the refetch settles. No test covers it.
findings.consequence: Momentary stale could-not-search message; self-corrects when the refetch settles.
findings.minimal_fix: Optional: reset settled when a fetch starts, or key settled by a fetch counter.

findings.title: Pending-folder test does not exercise the buildTree stale guard
findings.evidence: loadState is already 'loading' in the stale commit, so the test passes even if the entriesFolder guard at line 356 is removed; no console.error spy for duplicate keys.
findings.consequence: A regression of the key-collision protection would not fail the suite.
findings.minimal_fix: Use colliding entries (root README.md, docs/README.md) and assert console.error is not called.

notes: Finding ids renumbered F1/F2 -> F01/F02 by the coordinator to satisfy the schema; text unchanged.
